headline: Police Department outlined its 2026 JAG/Byrne grant application at a public hearing.
summary: Major John Carroll of the Police Department explained the 2026 JAG/Byrne Grant application and how the funding would support the department. Two mayoral proclamations were also received, one for Domestic Violence Awareness Month and one for Indigenous Peoples Day.
decisions: Received proclamation making October 2026 Domestic Violence Awareness Month in Central Falls.
Received proclamation making October 12, 2026 Indigenous Peoples Day in Central Falls.

City of Central Falls 
Special City Council Meeting  
580 Broad Street 
Central Falls, RI 02863 
Monday, October 5, 2026 
4:30 p.m. 
 
Minutes 
 
Posted: 
Time:  
 
I. Roll Call. 
 
 Council President Pro Tempore Alberto Rivas called the meeting to order at 4:38 p.m. and directed 
 City Clerk Alberto de Burgo to conduct the roll call. Present were Councilpersons Kazarian, Peguero, 
 Solano, and Rivas-Lugo. Councilpersons Rosado-Martinez and Baena, along with Council President 
 Ferri, were absent. A quorum was present. 
 
II. Pledge of Allegiance 
Council President Pro-Tempore Rivas -Lugo led the Council in the pledge of allegiance.  
 
III. Public Comment 
none 
 
IV. Executive Communications 
 
a) A proclamation of the Mayor of the City of Central Falls Proclaiming the Month of October 
2026, as Domestic Violence Awareness Month in the City of Central Falls. 
 Received 
b) A proclamation of the Mayor of the City of Central Falls Proclaiming the Month of October 
12, 2026, as Indigenous Peoples Day in the City of Central Falls. 
             Received 
 
V. Public Hearing pertaining to the Central Falls Police Department 2026 Application for JAG/Byrne 
Grant Funds. 
Major John Carroll of the Central Falls Police Department addressed the Council, providing an 
overview of the grant and explaining how the funding would support the Police Department and the 
services it provides. 
 
VI. Adjournment 
A motion to adjourn was made by Councilperson Peguero and Seconded by Councilperson Solano.  
The motion passed 4:42 pm 
 
Pursuant to Rhode Island General Laws § 42 -46-4, the City Council reserves the right to convene in executive session on any of the 
aforementioned items for one or more of the purposes listed in Rhode Island General Laws § 42-46-5(1)-(10)
